scope: Read-only merged source/API review, not frozen-engine benchmark verification; no performance claims for merged compiler.

findings.description: __tempCopy recognizes ordinary Arrays but treats nested typed word arrays as records, losing their list/vector length. Trusted ABI and README accept typed word arrays inside checked collections.
findings.consequence: A subsequent list count evaluates BigInt(undefined), and map/at_or lose collection shape.
findings.recommended_fix: Preserve typed-array collection shape when copying owned values, including typed arrays inside lists, vectors and records; add merged ownership tests.

checks.trusted_numeric_entries: Word/Bool native entries bind directly to generated implementations. f32/Int and nested representation conversion remains representation work, not validation.
checks.trusted_into: Destination APIs enforce caller capacity/nonaliasing/lifetime by contract; no new per-word checker, shape validation, fuel or profiling optimizer. Generated terminal output copies/loops preserve explicit destination semantics.
checks.state_and_owned_coexistence: State actions/keeps retain their separate bounded transaction fuel. Pure numeric function bodies have no ctx parameter or __tick. Owned helpers are internal, externally visible immutable-result functions and Into retain ordinary ABI.
checks.runtime: Explicit JavaScript full call bypasses pack/snapshot transport. CPU scalar32/64 capability selects declared scalar ABI. Packed prepared calls own dedicated Wasm instance with mark/rewind and borrowed-view lifetime; transport budgets and lifecycle checks are distinct from input proof validation.
checks.portable_proof_context: DefinitionContext checks exact typed body, formal parameter names and transitive callee IDs; full ordinary core checking/reification remains authoritative. Admission can succeed independently, but require_applicable guards empty selections and actual selection construction.
checks.version_boundary: Owned-only modules identify v3; concat and concat+owned identify v4. from_bytes recomputes actual semantics and rejects wrong tags. Explicit core sequence tests cover v3/v4 and old concat-v3 rejection.
checks.test_evidence: Read existing merged core/js logs and source tests; reviewer ran only a small saved-helper shape reproduction, no builds or benchmark timings.

mutations: Only this NEW main-integration/review receipt. No source, Git, frozen batch32, canonical knowledge or measured artifacts changed.
